purpose: Pre-flight smoke and go/no-go for SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-A-V1 and SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-B-V1, on four rows of the same roster chosen before any contact to bracket it (longest, shortest, median, p90 by duration). Four reads, in order of importance: (1) does the RE-DERIVED geometry -c 40960 -np 8 serve this card with the bf16 mmproj resident, on a 78.36 s encode that is 2.2x the longest encode the sealed ESB test flight ever sent; (2) do both ESB scorers resolve references from the NEW dev10 hash-pinned layer and score a sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch; (3) what is arm B's text envelope in tokens, so the window fit can be checked against a measurement rather than a bound; (4) a wall-time reading for the two flights' projection. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.

E22-ESB-DEV-SMOKE-4.selection: deterministic and pre-registered, the same rule the 2026-09-04 ESB test smoke used: the longest utterance (the window-fit and VRAM worst case), the shortest, the median and the p90 by duration, ties broken by sample id

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- identical to the flight
cells.factor: none; this is arm A's own protocol on four rows

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- identical to the flight
cells.factor: none; this is arm B's own protocol on the same four rows

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request
shared_protocol.instruction_arm_a: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
shared_protocol.instruction_arm_b: Transcribe the English audio into text.

evaluation.paper_facing_aggregation: corpus: total S+D+I over total reference words
metrics: prompt_tokens per request (the text envelope, per arm)
peak VRAM and any CUDA fault or out-of-memory
whether both ESB scorers returned per-sample rows through core.scoring_batch with verified = true

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4 rows x 1 contact x 2 arms = 8, plus generous headroom; the registered ceiling is 60. Both arms fly under ONE run id as two attempts, which core.attempts allows (the (run_id, attempt_id) key is one-time, and core/model/adapter.py meters the plan cumulatively across attempts of a run id).
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 96.959875 s per arm, 193.92 s for both, rounded to 200; the registered ceiling is 400.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.5, essentially all of it model load; the registered ceiling is 1.0

decision.go_no_go: Both flights launch only if all four reads are affirmative: the -c 40960 -np 8 geometry serves the 78.36 s worst case without an out-of-memory or CUDA fault; both ESB scorers return per-sample rows on both sealed manifests through core.scoring_batch with verified = true; the measured worst prompt plus 1024 completion tokens is at most half the 5120-token slot; and the projected flight time is at or under the registered per-arm ceiling.
decision.claim_surface: none; a smoke's numbers enter no verdict
